newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures contracts closed weaker on Thursday, as price losses on the Chicago market overnight triggered selling from local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 320 to 400 yen per tonne lower, with benchmark May 1998 closing 340 yen lower at 14,040 yen. The day's estimated trade volume was 66,303 lots.

Active selling from individual investors pressured the market throughout the day, traders said. "Local investors hold many long positions, and are quick to react to any bearish factor," a brokerage house trader said.
At 0747 GMT, the spot May corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was at $2.85-1/4 per bushel, against the $2.85-3/4 Wednesday close.
The spot May soybean contract on the CBOT overnight trading system stood at $8.63-1/4 per bushel, against the previous close of $8.69.
